description: This file defines the ImageInterface interface for image objects in Drupal, specifying methods for image validation, dimensions, file info, toolkit operations, transformations, and image processing.

classes.name: ImageInterface
classes.description: Interface for image objects, including methods for validation, size retrieval, format conversion, cropping, resizing, and transformations.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the image is valid.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the image file.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image file.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source path of the image file.

methods.name: getToolkit
methods.description: Returns the image toolkit used for this image file.

methods.name: getToolkitId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the image toolkit.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a toolkit operation to the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Closes the image and saves changes to a file.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Prepares a new image without loading from a file.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales an image while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: scaleAndCrop
methods.description: Scales and crops an image to exact dimensions.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an image to a specified format.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops an image to a specified rectangle.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specific dimensions, ignoring aspect ratio.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates an image by a specified number of degrees.
